Ranks all Montgomery census tracts by their total 2025 311 service request count, left-joining pre-aggregated tract counts so zero-request tracts appear with 0 and ordering by count descending with name as tiebreaker.
sql:
WITH tract_totals AS (
  SELECT geoid, SUM(n) AS request_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_ab8c31'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT t.name, COALESCE(tt.request_count, 0) AS request_count, t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN tract_totals tt ON t.geoid = tt.geoid
ORDER BY request_count DESC, t.name ASC
